title: Your Private World
description: Your Own Private World, right in the palm of your hand
body: This mod adds your very own private copy of the overworld, which you can access either via a special item, crafted with redstone, emeralds, and gold, and upon being right clicked will transport you to the new dimension. It is on the same seed as the overworld, and gives you the ability to test builds and do whatever you may like to.
